observations: Photo 0 shows the interior of a freezer with a white lid and a silver interior, showing some frost and residue.
Photo 1 shows the front of the freezer with a white exterior, a 'Haier Thermocool' sticker, and a control panel with a dial and indicator light. The bottom front corner is chipped and peeling paint.
Photo 2 shows the back of the freezer with a black wire cooling coil, a label with technical specifications, and a power cord plugged into the unit. The back panel is dirty and shows signs of wear.

claims.claim: Classic and reliable themocool freezer with a string capacity long lasting freezing for up to five...
claims.evidence: The brand 'Haier Thermocool' is visible in photo 1, but there is no visible proof of 'string capacity' or 'long lasting freezing' beyond the seller's words. The interior shows frost, suggesting it is currently freezing, but not necessarily for 'up to five' years.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The freezer may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the freezer running, with the interior light on and frost forming, and the control panel responding to the dial.

risks.risk: The freezer may have a damaged or non-functional cooling system, as shown by the dirty back panel and visible wear.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the cooling coil and compressor area, and a video of the unit running with the compressor active.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential cooling system failure

risks.risk: The freezer may have a leak or water damage, especially given the chipped paint and peeling at the bottom front corner.
risks.proof: A photo of the bottom of the freezer showing the interior and any signs of water leakage or mold.

proof_requests: Video of the freezer running with the interior light on and frost forming.
Close-up photo of the cooling coil and compressor area.
Photo of the bottom of the freezer showing the interior and any signs of water leakage or mold.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
